name: HZ_PARTY_CLASSIFICATION_DN
description:
The HZ_PARTY_CLASSIFICATION_DN is a column flattened denormalization table storing all ten primary classification code assignments per customer party. (one row per party) 
When a particular Auxiliary dimension profile option is not populated with a Classification Category selection, all of the associated columns for that dimension in this table will be null.
When there are no primary code assignments to a party for a particular Auxiliary dimension, the associated columns for that dimension will also be null.
Parties that do not have any class code assignments or no Primary class code assignments in any of the class categories mapped through the setup profile options will NOT have any corresponding rows in this column flattened denorm table.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).
